villa.contactSubtitle: Interested in renting? View the contact number to reach the host.
villa.showContactHint: We track interest to help owners understand demand for their villa.
villa.contactHidden: Tap the button above to see the phone number

dashboard.title: Owner dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Track performance of your villa listings
dashboard.emptyListings: You have not listed any villas yet.
dashboard.newVillaSubtitle: Fill in the details below. Your contact info is pre-filled from registration.
dashboard.addressHint: Google Maps picker coming soon. Enter the address manually for now.
dashboard.detailsPlaceholder: Describe the villa, amenities, rules, etc.
dashboard.infoTotalListings: The number of villa listings you have published on RentVilla.
dashboard.infoTotalViews: Counted each time someone opens your villa detail page. One view per browser session (if they refresh, it may count again in a new session).
dashboard.infoTotalContacts: Counted when a visitor clicks "Show contact number" on your listing — this means they are interested in renting.
dashboard.infoContactRate: Percentage of page views that led to a contact reveal: (contact reveals ÷ views) × 100. Higher is better.
dashboard.infoViewsLast7: Page views on your listings in the last 7 days.
dashboard.infoContactsLast7: Contact button clicks in the last 7 days.
dashboard.infoMostViewed: The listing with the highest total page views since it was published.
dashboard.infoMostContacted: The listing where visitors revealed your phone number the most — strongest rent intent.
dashboard.infoTopPerformer: Combined score: contacts weigh more than views. Highlights your best overall listing.
dashboard.infoTableViews: Total times this villa's detail page was opened.
dashboard.infoTableContacts: How many visitors clicked to see your phone number for this villa.
dashboard.infoTableConversion: For this villa: (contacts ÷ views) × 100. Shows how often viewers become interested renters.
dashboard.manageHint: Manage your listings — only visible when you are logged in.
